ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

18. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for plants environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Managing waste environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Light environment School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Sky its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
